description:
Position Overview 

 


 The Leading Hotels of the World is seeking an Associate Data Engineer to join our Enterprise Data team as part of the next phase of our data transformation. The Associate Data Engineer will support the development and maintenance of the data infrastructure and pipelines that turn enterprise data into reliable, reusable data products for reporting and analytics. 

 


 Working alongside senior engineers and cross-functional business and technology teams, this role will build and maintain data pipelines, contribute to data modeling, and help ensure data is clean, accessible, and reliable. This is an opportunity for someone with early professional experience to deepen their technical expertise while taking on greater ownership of data engineering workflows and contributing to DataOps and data engineering best practices. 

 


 This is a full-time position located in New York City. We offer flexible workplace policies that allow for working remotely 3 days a week and require being in our NYC office 2 days a week (Wednesdays and Thursdays).

 


 Key Responsibilities 

 


 Data Engineering & Data Products 

 
 Build, maintain, and optimize data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, and delivery. 

 Develop and maintain data models to support reporting and analytics use cases. 

 Contribute to the development of reliable, reusable data products. 

 Support the onboarding of new data sources. 

 Write efficient, scalable SQL queries and contribute to performance optimization. 

 
 
 

 Data Quality & Reliability 

 
 Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines to support reliability, performance, and accuracy. 

 Implement and support data quality checks and validation processes. 

 Apply established data governance standards within data engineering workflows. 

 Document data architecture, pipelines, and workflows with a focus on clarity and maintainability. 

 
 
 

 Business Partnership & Engineering Practices 

 
 Work cross-functionally with business and technology teams to deliver timely, high-quality data. 

 Contribute to DataOps processes and data engineering standards and best practices. 

 Assist in evaluating new tools and technologies. 


 
 


 Qualifications and Skills 

 
 Bachelor’s degree (BS) in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field and 2–4 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related technical role

 Strong proficiency in SQL and working knowledge of Python or a similar language. 

 Solid understanding of ETL/ELT processes, data modeling, and data warehousing concepts. 

 Hands-on experience with at least one modern data platform or tool (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, dbt, Airflow). 

 Experience with or exposure to the AWS technology stack, including AWS Glue, Amazon S3, Amazon Redshift, and Amazon Aurora MySQL. 

 Experience with or exposure to Spark. 

 Experience debugging data issues and working with production data pipelines. 

 Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 

 Ability to manage tasks independently and prioritize in a fast-paced environment. 

 Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams. 

 Ability to demonstrate LHW’s performance drivers: Accountability, Adaptability, Collaboration, Curiosity, and Empathy. 


 
 


 Compensation 

 Annualized Salary Range: $100,000 - $120,000

 Target Annual Incentive bonus: 10%

 **Actual base salary within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, and location.

 


 Benefits 

 The Leading Hotels of the World fosters a high-performance culture and generously rewards its employees for their contributions. Here is just a preview of the benefits we offer:

 


 
 22 days of Paid Time Off (PTO), 11 paid holidays, including birthdays as a floating holiday

 Medical coverage available within the first month

 Health Savings Account (HSA) with Company contribution

 401(k) company match up to 4% of salary

 Up to $500 for home office setup credit

 Up to $500 travel credit that supports and encourages our employees’ passion for travel

 Unlimited access to financial advisors Collaborative and inclusive work environment

 
 


 About The Leading Hotels of The World, Ltd. (LHW) 

 Comprised of more than 400 hotels in over 80 countries, LHW is the largest collection of independent luxury hotels. In 1928, 38 independent hoteliers came together to create LHW. Since then, the Company has carefully curated distinctive hotels, resorts, inns, chalets, villas, and safari camps from the snow-capped Alps of Europe to the African veldt, to share them with adventurous souls who seek the remarkably uncommon. The LHW community is filled of exceptional individuals, united by a passion for the surprising discoveries and details that come with every experience. LHW’s collection covers the globe and promises a broad range of destinations and uncommon experiences, enhanced by LHW’s tiered guest loyalty program Leaders Club. From converted former palaces, and countryside retreats run by the same families for generations, to gleaming skyscrapers in dynamic urban centers, serene private island escapes, glamorous tented camps - and beyond - explore, find inspiration, and experience unforgettable travel moments. For more information visit: www.lhw.com, Facebook at @LeadingHotels, Twitter at @LeadingHotels and Instagram @leadinghotelsoftheworld

 


 LHW is an equal opportunity employer. LHW does not discriminate on the basis of religion, race, creed, color, national origin, sex, age, disability, handicap, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic information or any other applicable legally protected category.
